contract: notes-based free-form part/pivot contract (not schema-enforced). Owner: Hermes. All coordinates in pixels, origin top-left, shared parent plane.

fixed_mast.contents: Timber mast, stone base, mast bands/brackets, guy ropes, mast coil rope (Rope2, wrapped around mast). Mast-top cap and fin-attachment band repaired where the vane head occluded them (inpainted from adjacent support pixels only).

movable_vane_head.contents: ENTIRE directional head as two rigid pieces sharing one rotation axis: (a) upper cross-arm + arrowhead (points right) + pivot pin + pivot bracket/straps/hook; (b) lower cloth-fin assembly: wooden frame + cloth fin + diagonal braces + mounting arm + arm strap + arm lashing knot + hanging rope (Rope1, tied to the knot). Arrow direction and palette preserved from the accepted reference; no mill/turbine.

rotation.axis: vertical line x=526 in the shared plane (mast centerline, measured from the fixed mast column)
rotation.pivot_note: Pivot point on the mast axis at the mast-top joint (center of the pivot-bracket sleeve, where the pin enters the mast cap). The whole head layer rotates rigidly about this vertical axis; the fixed mast does not move. No blind cutout rotations: the head was separated, never rotated, during production.

mountainward_angle: Runtime placement only. No mountainward/scenery angle is baked into either layer; both layers are transparent-background prop art with no scenery.
plane_camera_constraint: Same camera, same scale, same shared parent plane for both layers. The reference was a static side view; separation preserves exact pixel positions (mask-composite of the two layers reproduces the accepted reference pixel-identically). Runtime must composite fixed_mast first, movable_vane_head over it, then rotate the head layer about pivot_xy. Do not re-derive pivots by bbox fitting.
repair_scope: Only formerly occluded support pixels were repaired: (1) mast-top cap under the pivot-bracket straps (~432 px), (2) fin-attachment band + mast column under the fin arm (~502 px). One procedural inpaint pass (Telea) conditioned on the masked reference; no generative repaint. All other pixels are verbatim from the accepted reference.
rope_partition_note: Rope follows the physical assembly: the head keeps its own construction lashings (fin-frame ties, arm knot, hanging rope tied to the knot — they rotate with the head); the fixed mast keeps the mast rigging (coil rope wrapped around the mast, guy ropes to the stone base). Documented here because the request lists 'rope' under fixed_mast as a summary; the mast's ropes are fixed, the head's lashings move with the head.

shared_plane.note: Both layers use the identical 1010x2062 parent coordinate space of the accepted reference. No independent bbox fit, cropping, or stretching. Offsets are (0,0) for both layers.
